title: A Large Language Model Based Teaching Pathway Is Feasible for Developing Clinical Pharmacy Practice Competencies
summary: In a small feasibility study, an LLM-based simulated ward-round pathway produced pharmacy-trainee competency scores correlated with expert judgments but systematically underestimated them. It is not validated for high-stakes assessment.
ai_technology: An LLM-based simulated ward-round teaching pathway generates pharmacy-trainee competency scores for comparison with expert ratings.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: Scores were compared with expert judgments in a small feasibility study; systematic underestimation and lack of high-stakes validation limit interpretation.
evidence.unknown: External replication and real-world or clinical benefit were not established by the reviewed study; author affiliation is not stated in the reviewed material.
evidence.ai_role: An LLM-based simulated ward-round teaching pathway generates pharmacy-trainee competency scores for comparison with expert ratings.
